      "content": "# @huiliyi37/dsh-office\n\nEnglish | [中文](README.zh.md)\n\nOffice document tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`): generate, read, and edit spreadsheets (`.xlsx`), PDFs, presentations (`.pptx`), and Word documents (`.docx`).\n\nPorted from the office plugins of the [Tianshu](https://github.com/Tianshu-Tui) terminal coding agent (Apache-2.0 licensed upstream), adapted to the dsh cordis tool model.\n\n## Tools\n\n| Tool | What it does |\n| --- | --- |\n| `xlsx_read` | List sheets of a `.xlsx`, or read one sheet as a markdown table (range-limited for large files; formula text preserved) |\n| `xlsx_write` | Write a 2D array to a new `.xlsx` (formula cells, header bold, column widths, number formats) |\n| `xlsx_edit` | Edit an existing `.xlsx`: add sheets, update cells (value or formula), append rows |\n| `xlsx_recalc` | Recalculate every formula with a lightweight pure-TS engine and report error values (`#REF!`, `#DIV/0!`, `#VALUE!`, `#N/A`, `#NAME?`, `#NUM!`) with locations |\n| `xlsx_audit` | Statically audit formula structure: array-formula traps, aggregation ranges missing rows, formulas overwritten by hardcoded values, inconsistent formulas in a column, self-references, division by zero |\n| `pdf_create` | Generate a real PDF with headings, paragraphs, tables, lists, code blocks and footer page numbers; CJK text renders via an auto-detected system font |\n| `pdf_read` | Extract text from a PDF for reading into context |\n| `pdf_merge` | Merge multiple PDFs into one, in order |\n| `pdf_split` | Split a PDF into single-page files, or extract pages by spec (`\"1,3,5-7\"`) |\n| `pptx_create` | Generate a `.pptx` deck from slide definitions (title / section / content / two-column / image / table / chart), with optional theme and speaker notes |\n| `pptx_read` | Extract slide text as markdown, optionally including speaker notes; `include` adds structure (summary/layouts/images/tables: shape names & cm positions, image targets, table dims) |\n| `pptx_edit` | Find/replace text inside an existing `.pptx` (`<a:t>` surgery), preserving all layout and styling |\n| `docx_create` | Generate a real `.docx` Word document from content blocks (heading / paragraph / table / code / list), with optional striped tables, page background color, and diagonal text watermark |\n| `docx_read` | Extract text from a `.docx` for reading into context |\n\n## Install & load\n\n> **Compatibility**: `dsh` `0.1.0-rc.5`–`0.1.x` and the `0.2` line (including `0.2.0-rc.2`). DSH checks the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` peer range against the running `dsh` version, so `0.2.4` (`^0.1.0-rc.5` only) is rejected on `0.2.0-rc.2`. Cores on the `0.0.1` line are still refused: they install a second `dsh-tools` copy and crash every tool call with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`.\n\n### Full load (all 14 tools)\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile <name> add @huiliyi37/dsh-office\ndsh --profile <name>\n```\n\nThe first `dsh plugin` call initializes the profile (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`\nis its first bundle) and appends this package to the profile's `bundles` list.\nLaunching the profile then registers all tools automatically.\n\n### Load only the families you need\n\nPass a `config` row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` to enable/disable\nper family. Omitted families stay enabled; set a family to `false` to\nexclude it (useful to keep the tool surface small):\n\n```yaml\n# cordis.patch.yml\n- insert:\n    - id: dsh-office\n      name: '@huiliyi37/dsh-office'\n      config:\n        enable:\n          xlsx: false      # skip spreadsheet tools\n          pdf: true        # keep PDF tools\n          ppt: false       # skip presentations\n          docx: true       # keep Word tools\n```\n\nFamilies: `xlsx` (read/write/edit/recalc/audit), `pdf` (create/read/merge/split),\n`ppt` (create/read/edit), `docx` (create/read).\n\n### Uninstall\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile <name> remove @huiliyi37/dsh-office\n```\n\n### Manual alternative\n\nInstall the package anywhere Node resolution can find it and reference it\nfrom your own `cordis.patch.yml` (same `config.enable` switches apply):\n\n```sh\nnpm install @huiliyi37/dsh-office\n```\n\n```yaml\n# cordis.patch.yml\n- insert:\n    - id: dsh-office\n      name: '@huiliyi37/dsh-office'\n```\n\n## Skill\n\nThe package ships a usage skill (`skills/SKILL.md`, anthropics-compatible\nformat) that teaches the model large-file pagination and generation\ndiscipline. Returns null when the text is not a plain reference.\n */\nexport function parseReference(text: string, currentSheet: string): Range | null {\n  let rest = text.trim()\n  let sheet = currentSheet\n  const m = SHEET_NAME_RE.exec(rest)\n  if (m) {\n    sheet = (m[1] ?? m[2] ?? '')\n  const row = parseInt(m[4] ?? '0', 10)\n  if (col <= 0 || row <= 0) return null\n  return { col, row }\n}\n\nfunction colToIndex(col: string): number {\n  let result = 0\n  for (const ch of col.toUpperCase()) {\n    result = result * 26 + (ch.charCodeAt(0) - 64)\n  }\n  return result\n}\n\nexport function colToLetter(col: number): string {\n  let n = col\n  let out = ''\n  while (n > 0) {\n    const rem = (n - 1) % 26\n    out = String.fromCharCode(65 + rem) + out\n    n = Math.floor((n - 1) / 26)\n  }\n  return out\n}\n\n// ── formula tokenizer / parser ─────────────────────────────────────\n\ntype TokenType = 'num' | 'str' | 'range' | 'op' | 'func' | 'lparen' | 'rparen' | 'comma' | 'percent' | 'eof'\n\ninterface Token {\n  type: TokenType\n  value: string | number\n}\n\nfunction tokenize(formula: string): Token[] {\n  const tokens: Token[] = []\n  let i = 0\n  const n = formula.length\n  while (i < n) {\n    const ch = formula[i]!\n    if (ch === ' ' || ch === '\\t') {\n      i++\n      continue\n    }\n    if (ch === '\"') {\n      let j = i + 1\n      let s = ''\n      while (j < n && formula[j] !== '\"') {\n        s += formula[j]\n        j++\n      }\n      tokens.push({ type: 'str', value: s })\n      i = j + 1\n      continue\n    }\n    if (/[0-9.]/.test(ch)) {\n      let j = i\n      let sawE = false\n      while (j < n) {\n        const c = formula[j]!\n        if (/[0-9.]/.test(c)) {\n          j++\n        } else if ((c === 'e' || c === 'E') && !sawE && /[0-9+-]/.test(formula[j + 1] ?? /[0-9]/.test(text)) {\n        tokens.push({ type: 'num', value: Number(text) })\n        i = j\n        continue\n      }\n    }\n    // quoted sheet reference: 'Sheet Name'!A1\n    if (ch === \"'\") 'percent' : 'op'\n      tokens.push({ type: t, value: ch })\n      i++\n      continue\n    }\n    i++\n  }\n  tokens.push({ type: 'eof', value: '' })\n  return tokens\n}\n\n// ── evaluator ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\ninterface EvalContext {\n  wb: Workbook\n  formulaCache: Map<string, Value>\n  evalStack: Set<string>\n  steps: number\n  maxSteps: number\n  unknownFunctions: Set<string>\n}\n\nexport interface RecalcResult {\n  status: 'success' | 'errors_found'\n  total_formulas: number\n  total_errors: number\n  error_summary: Record<string, { count: number; locations: string[] }>\n  warnings: string[]\n}\n\ntype RangeArg = { kind: 'range'; range: Range }\ntype Arg = Value | RangeArg\n\nfunction isRangeArg(a: Arg): a is RangeArg {\n  return a !== null && typeof a === 'object' && (a as RangeArg).kind === 'range'\n}\n\ntype FnImpl = (args: Arg[], p: Parser) => Value\n\nclass Parser {\n  private pos = 0\n  readonly ctx: EvalContext\n\n  constructor(\n    private tokens: Token[],\n    ctx: EvalContext,\n    private sheet: string,\n  ) {\n    this.ctx = ctx\n  }\n\n  private peek(): Token {\n    return this.tokens[this.pos]!\n  }\n\n  private next(): Token {\n    return this.tokens[this.pos++]!\n  }\n\n  /** Parse one function argument: a bare range stays a RangeArg, anything\n   *  else evaluates to a scalar. */\n  private parseArg(): Arg {\n    const t = this.peek()\n    if (t.type === 'range') {\n      this.next()\n      const range = parseReference(String(t.value), this.sheet)\n      return range ? arith(left, right, (a, b) => a + b, ERR.value)\n          : arith(left, right, (a, b) => a - b, ERR.value)\n      } else {\n        return left\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  private parseMultiplicative(): Value {\n    let left = this.parsePower()\n    for (;;) {\n      const t = this.peek()\n      if (t.type === 'op' && (t.value === '*' || t.value === '/')) {\n        this.next()\n        const right = this.parsePower()\n        left = t.value === '*' ? arith(left, right, (a, b) => a * b, ERR.value) : divideValues(left, right)\n      } else {\n        return left\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  private parsePower(): Value {\n    const left = this.parseUnary()\n    const t = this.peek()\n    if (t.type === 'op' && t.value === '^') {\n      this.next()\n      const right = this.parsePower()\n      return arith(left, right, (a, b) => Math.pow(a, b), ERR.num)\n    }\n    return left\n  }\n\n  private parseUnary(): Value {\n    const t = this.peek()\n    if (t.type === 'op' && (t.value === '-' || t.value === '+')) {\n      this.next()\n      const v = this.parseUnary()\n      if (isErr(v)) return v\n      return typeof v === 'number' ? range.start.col, range.start.row)\n      }\n      case 'func': {\n        const name = String(t.value)\n        const args: Arg[] = []\n        if (this.peek().type === 'lparen') {\n          this.next()\n          if (this.peek().type !== 'rparen') {\n            args.push(this.parseArg())\n            while (this.peek().type === 'comma') {\n              this.next()\n              args.push(this.parseArg())\n            }\n          }\n          this.next() // rparen\n        }\n        return this.callFunction(name, args)\n      }\n      case 'lparen': {\n        const v = this.parseExpression()\n        this.next() // rparen\n        return v\n      }\n      default:\n        return ERR.value\n    }\n  }\n\n  getSheet(name: string): Worksheet | null {\n    const ws = this.ctx.wb.getWorksheet(name)\n    if (ws) return ws\n    const capitalized = name[0]?.toUpperCase() + name.slice(1)\n    return this.ctx.wb.getWorksheet(capitalized) ?? null\n  }\n\n  cellValue(ws: this.ctx.evalStack.delete(key)\n      } else if (obj.result !== undefined && obj.result !== null) {\n        v = coerceScalar(obj.result)\n      } else if (typeof obj.text === 'string') {\n        v = sub.parse()\n  }\n\n  private callFunction(name: string, args: Arg[]): Value {\n    const fn = FUNCTIONS[name]\n    if (!fn) {\n      this.ctx.unknownFunctions.add(name)\n      return ERR.name\n    }\n    try {\n      return fn(args, this)\n    } catch {\n      return ERR.value\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Collect every cell value in a range (missing sheets yield no cells). */\n  rangeValues(range: ({ err: s as ErrorCode } as Err) : s\n}\n\nfunction arith(a: Value, b: Value, op: (x: number, y: number) => number, err: Err): Value {\n  if (isErr(a)) return a\n  if (isErr(b)) return b\n  const an = a === null ? 0 : asNumber(a)\n  const bn = b === null ? 0 : asNumber(b)\n  if (an === null || bn === null) return err\n  const r = op(an, bn)\n  return Number.isFinite(r) ? r : err\n}\n\nfunction divideValues(a: Value, b: Value): Value {\n  if (isErr(a)) return a\n  if (isErr(b)) return b\n  const an = a === null ? 0 : asNumber(a)\n  const bn = b === null ? 0 : asNumber(b)\n  if (an === null || bn === null) return ERR.value\n  if (bn === 0) return ERR.div0\n  const r = an / bn\n  return Number.isFinite(r) ? r : ERR.div0\n}\n\nfunction compareValues(a: Value, b: Value, op: string): boolean {\n  let cmp: number\n  if (isErr(a) || isErr(b)) {\n    cmp = isErr(a) && isErr(b) && a.err === b.err ? num : c\n  }\n  if (value === null) return false\n  return compareValues(value, target, op)\n}\n\n/** Sum over a range with a row offset for SUMIF/AVERAGEIF-style pairing. */\nfunction pairedValue(range: Range, offset: number, p: Parser): Value | null {\n  const ws = p.getSheet(range.sheet)\n  if (!ws) return null\n  const row = range.start.row + offset\n  if (row > range.end.row) return null\n  return p.cellValue(ws, range.start.col, row)\n}\n\n// ── function table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconst FUNCTIONS: Record<string, FnImpl> = {\n  SUM: (args, p) => {\n    let sum = 0\n    for (const a of args) {\n      if (isErr(scalarOf(a, p))) return scalarOf(a, p)\n      if (isRangeArg(a)) {\n        for (const v of p.rangeValues(a.range)) {\n          if (isErr(v)) return v\n          const n = asNumber(v)\n          if (n !== null) sum += n\n        }\n      } else {\n        const n = asNumber(a)\n        if (n !== null) sum += n\n      }\n    }\n    return sum\n  },\n  AVERAGE: (args, p) => {\n    const vals = collectNumeric(args, p)\n    if (vals.err) return vals.err\n    return vals.nums.length === 0 ? 0 : Math.min(...vals.nums)\n  },\n  MAX: (args, p) => {\n    const vals = collectNumeric(args, p)\n    if (vals.err) return vals.err\n    return vals.nums.length === 0 ? 0 : Math.max(...vals.nums)\n  },\n  PRODUCT: (args, p) => {\n    const vals = collectNumeric(args, p)\n    if (vals.err) return vals.err\n    return vals.nums.length === 0 ? ''\n  if (!text.trim()) return 'DOCX appears to contain no extractable text.'\n  const truncated = text.length > DOCX_READ_CHAR_CAP\n    ? text.slice(0, DOCX_READ_CHAR_CAP) + `\\n\\n...
